messages:
Maya: Noticing a weird cascade in eu-west-1 — after the audit retention tweak yesterday, log-shipper started pushing ~3x events to SIEM and S3. GPU nodes hitting high S3 GET latency and KMS decrypt 5xxs, warm pool join times ballooned. Anyone else seeing model checkouts fail?
Arjun: Yep, saw the S3/GetObject 500 spikes. CI health checks started timing out when fetching checkpoints.
Sven: We rolled the audit retention from 7d -> 30d which enabled full-flow sampling. That increased log volume to our central shipper. I can share the commit: ```hcl
# modules/observability/vars.tf
variable "audit_retention_days" { default = 30 }
```
Sven: Shipments to SIEM also hit our ingest QPS limit, so the shipper started retrying and backing up to S3. That caused a burst of KMS decrypt calls (SSE-KMS) when our nodes tried to fetch model blobs.
oncall-net: Net view: no FW rule changes concurrent, but we are seeing sustained high TCP churn on border NATs to S3 endpoints (~150k conn/s). NAT autoscaler hasn't kicked yet because metrics are slightly below threshold.
oncall-net: NAT connstats: `Conntrack entries: 420k / max 500k` and `TCP retransmits up 12%`.
Maya: Warm pool snapshot: 9/40 ready (was 36/40), 31 nodes failing at "fetching model checkpoint" with repeated KMS:Throttling and S3:SlowDown.
Arjun: Short term mitigations: 1) throttle shipper backpressure (reduce sampling), 2) switch checkpoint access to presigned URLs to bypass SSE-KMS for the fetch path, 3) temporarily increase NAT conntrack and scale thresholds.
Sven: We can revert retention to 7d but that loses the longer window for compliance. Alternative: set shipper to async-batch to SIEM and buffer less to S3. I'll author a patch: reduce sampling and enable batching.
Maya: Presigned URLs would avoid KMS decrypt calls for node download but we need to ensure ACLs and signed URL TTLs are safe. Suggest 10m TTL for prewarm path.
Arjun: Quick AWS CLI to generate presigned (example): `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-models/prod/foo.pt --expires-in 600`
Arjun: Also adding retry jitter and exponential backoff to the model-fetcher to avoid synchronized storm.
Sven: Patching shipper now to set audit_retention_days = 7 for eu-west-1 and reduce flow sampling to 1/10 for a week. Will open PR and tag urgent/infraprod.
LogBot: Alert: SIEM ingest rate limit breached (rule: siem.ingest.qps) — 2026-03-21T14:07:12Z
LogBot: Alert: KMS throttle rate high for kms-key/redwood-models — 2026-03-21T14:09:03Z
Sven: PR created: infra/observability#1209 (draft) with plan to set retention=7 for eu-west-1 and enable shipper batching.
Maya: Can someone flip presign path for warm pool once PR merges? We want model warm path to use presigned links immediately.
Arjun: I can coordinate deploy. Also bumping NAT conntrack to 1M on the two border ASGs as temporary buffer. Command: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=1000000` — will roll via SSM runbook.
oncall-net: Please don't forget to adjust autoscaler thresholds so we don't oscillate. I'll add a temporary lower threshold for 30m.
Maya: After fixes, ticket followups: 1) cost review for extra S3 egress/audit storage, 2) long-term: move checkpoint storage to a private-backed CDN in region to avoid cross-region KMS/SSE issues, 3) add runbook entry for "audit retention -> shipper pressure -> KMS throttling". Filing INFRA-4977.
Sven: Merged shipper revert (apply-2026-03-21-14:18). Shipments dropping, SIEM QPS back under limit.
LogBot: Notice: S3 SlowDown and KMS throttle rates decreasing — 2026-03-21T14:23:40Z
Maya: Warm pool recovering 28/40 ready. Monitoring for 1hr. If model fetch errors > 5% again, escalate to oncall-storage.
Arjun: Noted. Also running a retrospective to see if we can simulate shipper load in staging before retention changes.
